designationHistory.name: Montezuma Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Sept. 12, 1938, as the Montezuma Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 7971, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Montezuma National Wildlife Refuge was established by Executive Order 7971 on September 12, 1938 “...as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife...” Montezuma NWR has acquired lands under the authority of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act (16 U.S.C. 715-715r), as amended, “...for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds.”
